articles.title_en: Combating cross-border externalities: Evidence from China’s inter-provincial ecological compensation initiatives
articles.title_cn: 应对跨区域外部性：来自中国省际生态补偿计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine China’s Ecological Compensation Initiative (ECI), which facilitates cross-provincial payments to reduce pollution in the Xin’an River. Using firm-level data, we find the policy significantly reduced upstream emissions, especially among firms closer to the river’s boundary. The ECI also increased firm exits and reduced new entries. A cost-benefit analysis shows that both upstream and downstream provinces benefited, as did the central government, supporting the ECI’s long-term feasibility and durability. Evidence from similar later programs highlights the ECI’s broader relevance, suggesting that well-designed compensation schemes can effectively address cross-jurisdictional environmental externalities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究中国的生态补偿计划（ECI），该计划促进跨省支付以减少新安江的污染。利用企业层面数据，我们发现该政策显著减少了上游排放，尤其是靠近河流边界的企业。ECI还增加了企业退出并减少了新进入。成本效益分析显示，上游和下游省份以及中央政府均受益，支持了ECI的长期可行性和持久性。来自类似后期项目的证据强调了ECI的更广泛相关性，表明设计良好的补偿方案能有效解决跨辖区环境外部性问题。

articles.title_en: School equalization in the shadow of Jim Crow: Causes and consequences of resource disparity in Mississippi circa 1940
articles.title_cn: 吉姆·克劳阴影下的学校均等化：密西西比州约1940年资源差距的成因与后果
articles.abstract_en: Mississippi’s 1920 school finance equalization program failed to benefit many of the state’s Black students—an outcome emblematic of broader patterns in the segregated U.S. South Bond (1934). In majority-Black districts, local officials disproportionately allocated funds from the state’s existing per capita fund to white schools. These elevated expenditures on white students rendered such districts ineligible for equalization aid, excluding Black students from its intended benefits. While Black students in majority-white districts experienced improvements in school spending and standards, those in majority-Black districts continued to endure extremely low—in some cases declining—levels of school funding. Exploiting variation in school spending induced by this so-called equalization policy, we document a tragedy in racist public policy. We estimate large positive marginal effects of local educational spending on Black students’ enrollment rates, educational attainment, and lifetime earnings. In contrast, estimated impacts of marginal spending on white students are minimal. A reallocation of funding toward Black students might have substantially improved their well-being at little cost to white students.
articles.abstract_cn: 密西西比州1920年的学校财政均等化计划未能惠及该州许多黑人学生——这一结果体现了美国南部种族隔离地区更广泛的模式（Bond, 1934）。在黑人占多数的学区，地方官员不成比例地将州现有的人均基金分配给白人学校。这些对白人学生的高额支出使得这些学区不符合均等化援助的资格，从而将黑人学生排除在其预期收益之外。虽然白人占多数学区的黑人学生在学校支出和标准方面有所改善，但黑人占多数学区的黑人学生继续承受极低——在某些情况下甚至下降——的学校资助水平。利用这一所谓均等化政策引起的学校支出差异，我们记录了种族主义公共政策中的一场悲剧。我们估计，地方教育支出对黑人学生的入学率、教育成就和终身收入有较大的正向边际效应。相比之下，对白人学生边际支出的估计影响微乎其微。将资金重新分配给黑人学生可能在不损害白人学生利益的情况下大幅改善他们的福祉。

articles.title_en: Crowding out crowd support? Substitution between formal and informal insurance
articles.title_cn: 挤出群众支持？正式保险与非正式保险之间的替代关系
articles.abstract_en: Interpersonal gifts and loans play an underexplored informal insurance role in high-income countries, posing challenges for social insurance policy design. I examine informal support via person-to-person (P2P) payment platforms using a survey-linked administrative bank transaction dataset covering low-income US users with job loss. Event study estimates show average monthly P2P inflows increase by 1.1 % of lost income one month after job loss before returning to baseline over 10 months. Single mothers receive the largest increases, as do those with high prior earnings or those living in high-income areas. Exploiting three plausibly exogenous changes to federal pandemic UI policy, I estimate that an additional dollar of UI benefits crowds out at most $0.05 of informal transfers. These results imply that UI can raise welfare by pooling risk across networks without reducing within-network risk pooling through informal insurance.
articles.abstract_cn: 人际间的礼物和贷款在高收入国家扮演着未被充分探索的非正式保险角色，这对社会保险政策设计构成了挑战。我利用一项结合调查的行政银行交易数据集，研究了通过个人对个人（P2P）支付平台提供的非正式支持，该数据集覆盖了经历失业的美国低收入用户。事件研究估计显示，在失业后一个月，平均每月P2P流入增加相当于失业收入的1.1%，随后在10个月内回归基线水平。单亲母亲获得的增加最大，高收入者或居住在高收入地区的人也是如此。利用联邦疫情失业政策的三个看似外生的变化，我估计额外一美元的失业救济金最多挤出$0.05的非正式转移。这些结果表明，失业救济金可以通过跨网络汇集风险来提高福利，而不会减少通过非正式保险进行的网络内风险分担。

articles.title_en: Accounting for the profits of multinational enterprises: Double counting and misattribution of foreign affiliate income
articles.title_cn: 跨国企业利润核算：外国附属机构收入的重复计算与错误归属
articles.abstract_en: Given the perception that multinational enterprises (MNEs) engage in extensive tax planning, ending base erosion and profit shifting activity is a priority on many national agendas. Yet the actual level of such activity is subject to debate. In this paper, we provide guidance on how to accurately measure country-level MNE income using the datasets commonly used in research on profit shifting. This issue is of global concern, as any economic data that reports profits by jurisdiction must use an established accounting method to report the activity of the MNEs’ indirectly owned foreign affiliates. We explain how the accounting method could lead a researcher to double count income or to attribute it to the wrong jurisdiction. Such errors not only affect measures of the MNEs’ country-level profits, but also bias researchers’ estimates of the sensitivity of income to taxes. Although we focus our analysis on data from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), we illustrate the consequences of such mismeasurement across a variety of studies relying on a variety of data sources.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于跨国企业（MNEs）被认为广泛进行税务筹划，消除税基侵蚀和利润转移活动已成为许多国家议程上的优先事项。然而，此类活动的实际水平仍存在争议。在本文中，我们提供了如何利用利润转移研究中常用的数据集准确衡量国家层面跨国企业收入的指导。这一问题具有全球关注度，因为任何按司法管辖区报告利润的经济数据都必须采用既定的会计方法来报告跨国企业间接拥有的外国附属机构的活动。我们解释了会计方法如何可能导致研究者重复计算收入或将其归属于错误的司法管辖区。此类错误不仅影响跨国企业国家层面利润的衡量，还会使研究者对收入对税收敏感性的估计产生偏差。尽管我们的分析聚焦于美国经济分析局（BEA）的数据，但我们通过依赖多种数据来源的多项研究，展示了这种错误衡量的后果。

articles.title_en: Party politics, inter-jurisdictional cooperation and law enforcement: Evidence from Mexico
articles.title_cn: 政党政治、跨辖区合作与执法：来自墨西哥的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how partisan politics affect inter-jurisdictional cooperation and public good provision in federal systems. We focus on law enforcement in Mexico, a country marked by high violent crime and strong partisan cleavages. Using a Regression Discontinuity Design in close municipal elections, we show that municipalities where the party in power in most neighbors barely won are more likely to cooperate with their neighbors on law enforcement than those where it barely lost, especially during periods of widespread violence. Such cooperation, in turn, improves crime prevention and significantly reduces homicide rates, with effects increasing the more neighbors are governed by the same party. These results hold regardless of party identity, incumbency, or cooperation with federal or state authorities. Overall, our findings indicate that while horizontal cooperation can improve local public goods in the presence of geographical spillovers, partisan divisions may hinder this process.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究党派政治如何影响联邦制下的跨辖区合作与公共品供给。我们聚焦于墨西哥的执法问题，该国以高暴力犯罪率和强烈的党派分歧为特征。利用市政选举中接近获胜的断点回归设计，我们发现在大多数邻居执政党勉强获胜的市政当局，比那些勉强失败的市政当局更有可能在执法方面与邻居合作，尤其是在暴力广泛蔓延的时期。这种合作反过来改善了犯罪预防，并显著降低了凶杀率，且随着更多邻居由同一政党执政，效果增强。这些结果在政党身份、现任地位或与联邦或州当局合作方面均保持一致。总体而言，我们的发现表明，虽然横向合作在地理溢出存在时可以改善地方公共品，但党派分歧可能阻碍这一过程。

articles.title_en: Regulating quasi-legal markets: Evidence from pain management clinic laws
articles.title_cn: 监管准合法市场：来自疼痛管理诊所法的证据
articles.abstract_en: The opioid crisis has often been fueled by its simultaneous interaction with both medical and illicit markets, including “pill mills” that distribute legal substances in inappropriate and quasi-legal ways. Pain management clinic laws (PMCLs) aim to address this property by enforcing stricter regulatory licensing requirements and regulatory oversight on opioid prescribing establishments. Using a difference-in-differences framework and Medicare claims data, we find that PMCLs reduce problematic opioid prescribing and doctor shopping. Drawing on transaction-level information on opioid shipments, we estimate that PMCLs lead to strikingly large reductions in the volume of opioids dispensed directly by practitioners to patients. Studying mortality data, we estimate reductions in overdose death rates involving prescription opioids, with little evidence of substitution to illicit opioid markets. As PMCLs have not been adopted in most states, our results suggest they warrant greater attention from policymakers, even amid the declining role of prescription opioids in the annual death toll of the opioid crisis.
articles.abstract_cn: 阿片类药物危机往往因其与医疗和非法市场的同时互动而加剧，包括以不适当和准合法方式分发合法物质的“药丸工厂”。疼痛管理诊所法（PMCLs）旨在通过加强对阿片类药物开具机构的监管许可要求和监督来应对这一特性。利用双重差分框架和医疗保险索赔数据，我们发现PMCLs减少了有问题的阿片类药物开具和医生购物行为。利用阿片类药物运输的交易层面信息，我们估计PMCLs导致从业者直接向患者分发的阿片类药物数量大幅减少。通过研究死亡率数据，我们估计涉及处方阿片类药物的过量死亡率有所下降，且几乎没有证据表明向非法阿片类药物市场转移的替代效应。由于大多数州尚未采纳PMCLs，我们的结果表明，即使在处方阿片类药物在阿片类药物危机年度死亡人数中作用下降的情况下，它们也应引起政策制定者的更多关注。

articles.title_en: Optimal regulation and investment incentives in financial networks
articles.title_cn: 金融网络中的最优监管与投资激励
articles.abstract_en: We examine the optimal regulation of financial networks with debt interdependencies between financial firms. We first show that firms often have incentives to choose excessively risky portfolios and to overly correlate their portfolios with those of their counterparties. We then characterize how optimal regulation depends on a firm’s financial centrality and its available investment opportunities. In standard core–periphery networks, optimal regulation depends non-monotonically on the correlation of banks’ investments, with maximal restrictions at intermediate levels of correlation. Moreover, it can be uniquely optimal to treat banks asymmetrically—restricting the investments of one core bank while allowing an otherwise identical core bank (identical in all aspects, including network centrality) to invest freely.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有债务相互关联的金融企业间金融网络的最优监管问题。首先，我们表明企业往往有动机选择过度风险的投资组合，并使其投资组合与交易对手的投资组合过度相关。然后，我们刻画了最优监管如何取决于企业的金融中心性及其可获得的投资机会。在标准的核心-外围网络中，最优监管对银行投资的相关性呈非单调依赖，在中等相关性水平下限制最为严格。此外，可能唯一最优的做法是对银行进行不对称对待——限制一家核心银行的投资，而允许另一家在所有方面（包括网络中心性）完全相同的核心银行自由投资。

articles.title_en: The nonlinear effects of fiscal policy
articles.title_cn: 财政政策的非线性效应
articles.abstract_en: We argue that the fiscal multiplier of government purchases increases with the size of the spending shock: more expansionary government spending shocks generate larger multipliers and more contractionary shocks generate smaller multipliers. We empirically document this pattern across time, countries, and modes of financing. We propose a neoclassical mechanism that hinges on the relationship between fiscal shocks, their form of financing, and the response of labor supply across the wealth distribution. An incomplete markets model predicts that the aggregate labor supply elasticity increases with the spending shock, and this holds regardless of whether shocks are deficit- or balanced-budget financed. We show that this mechanism survives the introduction of nominal price rigidities and find evidence for it using micro-data for the US.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们认为，政府购买的财政乘数随支出冲击的规模而增加：更具扩张性的政府支出冲击产生更大的乘数，而更具收缩性的冲击产生更小的乘数。我们通过时间、国家和融资方式的跨维度数据实证记录了这一模式。我们提出了一种新古典机制，该机制依赖于财政冲击、其融资形式以及劳动供给在财富分布上的反应之间的关系。一个不完全市场模型预测，总劳动供给弹性随支出冲击而增加，且无论冲击是通过赤字融资还是平衡预算融资，这一结论均成立。我们表明，该机制在引入名义价格刚性后依然成立，并利用美国微观数据为其提供了证据。

articles.title_en: The role of unrealized gains and borrowing in the taxation of the rich
articles.title_cn: 未实现收益与借贷在富人税收中的作用
articles.abstract_en: As deficits rise and concerns about tax avoidance by the rich increase, we study how unrealized gains and borrowing affect Americans’ income taxes. We have four main findings: First, measuring “economic income” as currently-taxed income plus new unrealized gains, the income tax base captures 60 % of economic income of the top 1 % of wealth-holders (and 71 % adjusting for inflation) and the vast majority of income for lower wealth groups. Second, adjusting for unrealized gains substantially lessens the degree of progressivity in the income tax, although it remains largely progressive. Third, we quantify for the first time the amount of borrowing across the full wealth distribution. Focusing on the top 1 %, while total borrowing is substantial, new borrowing each year is fairly small (1–2 % of economic income) compared to their new unrealized gains, suggesting that “buy, borrow, die” is not a dominant tax avoidance strategy for the rich. Fourth, consumption is less than liquid income for rich Americans, partly because the rich have a large amount of liquid income, and partly because their savings rates are high, suggesting that the main tax avoidance strategy of the super-rich is “buy, save, die.”
articles.abstract_cn: 随着赤字上升和对富人避税行为的担忧加剧，我们研究了未实现收益和借贷如何影响美国人的所得税。我们有四个主要发现：第一，将“经济收入”衡量为当前应税收入加上新增未实现收益，所得税税基覆盖了财富排名前1%人群经济收入的60%（经通胀调整后为71%），并且覆盖了较低财富群体收入的绝大部分。第二，调整未实现收益后，所得税的累进程度显著降低，尽管其总体上仍保持累进性。第三，我们首次量化了整个财富分布中的借贷规模。聚焦于前1%的人群，尽管总借贷规模可观，但每年新增借贷相对于其新增未实现收益而言相当小（占经济收入的1-2%），这表明“买入、借贷、死亡”并非富人主要的避税策略。第四，富人的消费低于其流动性收入，部分原因是富人拥有大量流动性收入，部分原因是他们的储蓄率较高，这表明超级富豪的主要避税策略是“买入、储蓄、死亡”。

articles.title_en: Do gender board quotas matter for working mothers? Evidence from state-owned firms in Italy
articles.title_cn: 董事会性别配额对职场母亲有影响吗？来自意大利国有企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: In developed countries, the absence of family friendly workplace policies is seen as an important driver of low fertility rates. In this paper we examine whether the introduction of gender quota on boards of directors indirectly lead to an increase in fertility and improvements of careers of young mothers working in companies subject to the quota. We exploit the introduction of an Italian law mandating a strict gender quota on the boards of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in 2013 and leverage matched administrative data on firms and employees from 2008 to 2019. Using a triple-difference-in-differences design, we show that the law substantially increased female board representation. But we find no significant effects on fertility proxied by mandatory maternity leaves, post-childbirth retention, parental leave uptake, or wage penalties following maternity. Overall, the results suggest that while gender quotas successfully diversify leadership, they do not, in isolation, transform workplace practices or mitigate structural disadvantages faced by working mothers.
articles.abstract_cn: 在发达国家，缺乏家庭友好型工作场所政策被视为低生育率的重要驱动因素。本文考察了董事会性别配额的引入是否间接导致生育率提高以及受配额约束公司中年轻母亲职业发展的改善。我们利用意大利一项法律在2013年强制要求国有企业（SOEs）董事会实行严格性别配额的引入，并利用2008年至2019年企业和员工的匹配行政数据。采用三重差分法设计，我们显示该法律显著提高了女性董事会代表性。但我们发现对以强制性产假、产后留任、育儿假使用或产后工资惩罚为代理的生育率没有显著影响。总体而言，结果表明，虽然性别配额成功实现了领导层的多元化，但单独来看，它们并未改变工作场所实践或缓解职场母亲面临的结构性劣势。

articles.title_en: How substitutable are the classical and radical right?
articles.title_cn: 古典右翼与激进右翼的可替代性如何？
articles.abstract_en: Over the last two decades, a new generation of right-wing parties and leaders has emerged worldwide. A central question is how substitutable voters perceive these parties to be relative to the classical right. We address this question using a quasi-natural experiment from Spain’s 2023 general election. Due to a last-minute candidate withdrawal, the radical right (Vox) could not run in one constituency. This unexpected event, unrelated to economic or ideological fundamentals, allows us to estimate the effects of radical right parties on electoral outcomes. Using a synthetic difference-in-differences design, we find that the classical right captured 82.9 % of the radical right vote. The radical right’s absence also slightly increased the vote share for left-wing parties and nearly doubled protest voting. These effects are stronger in high-unemployment areas, suggesting that the classical and radical right are less likely to be viewed as substitutes there. Additional analyses using survey data corroborate our findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，全球范围内出现了一代新的右翼政党和领导人。一个核心问题是，选民认为这些政党相对于古典右翼的可替代性有多高。我们利用西班牙2023年大选中的一个准自然实验来探讨这一问题。由于候选人最后一刻退出，激进右翼（Vox）无法在一个选区参选。这一意外事件与经济或意识形态基本面无关，使我们能够估计激进右翼政党对选举结果的影响。采用合成双重差分设计，我们发现古典右翼获得了激进右翼选票的82.9%。激进右翼的缺席也略微增加了左翼政党的得票率，并使抗议投票几乎翻倍。这些效应在高失业率地区更为显著，表明在这些地区古典右翼和激进右翼更不可能被视为可替代的。使用调查数据的额外分析证实了我们的发现。

articles.title_en: The impact of unexpected delays in periodic payments on consumption
articles.title_cn: 周期性支付意外延迟对消费的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study how unexpected delays in periodic payments affect spending behavior. Our empirical approach uses transaction-level data on income and spending and exploits quasi-random delays in the receipt of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits. Spending drops by about half of the loss in income that occurs while individuals wait for UI benefits, revealing the value of periodic payments for liquidity-constrained individuals. Once delayed payments are received as lump sums, individuals reallocate spending toward less commonly purchased big-ticket categories that are dominated by durables.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究周期性支付的意外延迟如何影响支出行为。我们的实证方法使用收入和支出的交易级数据，并利用失业保险（UI）福利领取中准随机的延迟。在个人等待UI福利期间，支出下降约为收入损失的一半，这揭示了周期性支付对流动性受限个体的价值。一旦延迟支付以一次性款项形式收到，个人会将支出重新分配至较少购买的、以耐用品为主的大件商品类别。

articles.title_en: Dynamics of evasion around tax thresholds: Evidence from Indian firms
articles.title_cn: 逃税阈值附近的动态调整：来自印度企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: How do firms respond to size-based thresholds when dynamic responses matter? Using the context of an Indian revenue-based tax registration threshold that selectively affected some firms, coupled with administrative tax data, we examine how firm growth responds to a threshold. We find that firms respond by slowing down growth in reported revenue below the threshold by around 14 percentage points or roughly 42 % of average growth. A lack of corresponding change in reported costs suggests an evasion response rather than a real response by firms. We show that an increase in audit probability on crossing the threshold, rather than an increase in tax liability or compliance costs is the likely reason for firm slowdown. We rationalize our empirical findings by modifying the standard Allingham-Sandmo model of evasion to a dynamic setting. We use this framework to calculate deadweight loss due to a threshold when dynamic responses are relevant and find that the welfare cost can be substantial in the long run.
articles.abstract_cn: 当动态响应重要时，企业如何应对基于规模的阈值？利用印度一个基于收入的税收登记阈值（该阈值选择性地影响了一些企业）的背景，结合行政税收数据，我们考察了企业增长如何响应这一阈值。我们发现，企业通过将报告收入增长放缓至阈值以下约14个百分点或约为平均增长的42%来做出回应。报告成本缺乏相应变化表明这是一种逃税回应，而非企业的实际回应。我们表明，跨越阈值后审计概率的增加，而非税收负担或合规成本的增加，是企业放缓的可能原因。我们通过将标准的Allingham-Sandmo逃税模型修改为动态设定来解释我们的实证发现。我们利用这一框架计算在动态响应相关时阈值造成的无谓损失，并发现长期福利成本可能相当可观。

articles.abstract_en: This paper measures the effects of state corporate and personal income tax reforms on business entry using an event study research design. We focus on reforms that do not coincide with federal tax changes, are preceded and followed by stable tax policy, and substantially change tax burdens. Corporate tax reforms cause meaningful changes in business entry: we measure a 5-year elasticity of 2.7 with respect to the net-of-tax rate. This is driven by large effects of tax cuts. Corporate tax cuts also reduce the predicted growth potential of entrants. We do not find strong evidence of cross-border spillovers, and find no evidence that personal income tax reforms affect business entry.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文采用事件研究设计，衡量了州级企业所得税和个人所得税改革对企业进入的影响。我们聚焦于那些与联邦税收变动不重合、改革前后税收政策稳定且税负发生实质性变化的改革。企业所得税改革对企业进入产生了显著影响：我们测得的净税率5年弹性为2.7。这一结果主要由减税的大效应驱动。企业所得税减税还降低了新进入企业的预期增长潜力。我们未发现跨境溢出效应的强有力证据，也未发现个人所得税改革影响企业进入的证据。

articles.title_en: Laptops in the long run: Evidence from the one laptop per child program in rural Peru
articles.title_cn: 长期中的笔记本电脑：来自秘鲁农村“每童一机”项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines a large-scale randomized evaluation of the One Laptop Per Child (OLPC) program in 531 Peruvian rural primary schools. We use administrative data on academic performance and grade progression over 10 years to estimate the long-run effects of increased computer access on (i) school performance over time and (ii) students’ educational trajectories. Following schools over time, we find no significant effects on academic performance but some evidence of negative effects on grade progression. Following students over time, we find no significant effects on primary and secondary completion, academic performance in secondary school, or university enrollment. Survey data indicate that computer access significantly improved students’ computer skills but not their cognitive skills; treated teachers received some training but did not improve their digital skills and showed limited use of technology in classrooms, suggesting the need for additional pedagogical support.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了秘鲁531所农村小学中“每童一机”（OLPC）项目的大规模随机评估。我们使用10年间的学业表现和年级晋升的行政数据，来估计增加计算机接入对（i）随时间变化的学业表现和（ii）学生教育轨迹的长期影响。跟踪学校随时间的变化，我们发现对学业表现没有显著影响，但对年级晋升有一些负面影响的证据。跟踪学生随时间的变化，我们发现对小学和中学完成率、中学学业表现或大学入学率没有显著影响。调查数据表明，计算机接入显著提高了学生的计算机技能，但未提高其认知技能；受训教师接受了一些培训，但数字技能未提升，且在课堂上对技术的使用有限，这表明需要额外的教学支持。

articles.title_en: Air pollution and workplace accidents: Evidence and implications
articles.title_cn: 空气污染与工作场所事故：证据与启示
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of air pollution on workplace accidents and permanent disabilities in Italy, a setting characterized by stringent air pollution and work safety regulations. Using daily administrative data between 2014 and 2018, we leverage winter heating regulations and atmospheric dynamics to address the endogeneity of air pollution generation and exposure. We find an elasticity of accidents with respect to particulate matter (PM10) of 0.12 and estimate no effect of pollution on disabilities. Using age groups as a proxy for work experience, we find larger impacts for less experienced workers. Increasing PM10 by 10 µ g/m3 would raise the average cost of an accident by 78 euros (7.3 %); employers bear 60 % of this cost, and public insurers bear 40 %.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估算了空气污染对意大利工作场所事故和永久性残疾的影响，该国以严格的空气污染和工作安全法规为特征。利用2014年至2018年间的每日行政数据，我们借助冬季供暖法规和大气动力学来解决空气污染产生和暴露的内生性问题。我们发现事故对颗粒物（PM10）的弹性为0.12，并估计污染对残疾没有影响。使用年龄组作为工作经验的代理变量，我们发现对经验较少的工人的影响更大。PM10每增加10 µg/m3，事故的平均成本将增加78欧元（7.3%）；雇主承担该成本的60%，公共保险公司承担40%。

articles.abstract_en: We examine how sustainable infrastructure investments affect household financial outcomes by studying the impact of subway expansions on mortgage repayment behavior in Delhi, India. Using administrative data from one of India’s largest mortgage lenders, we find that households in postal codes with newly opened stations experience a 4.42% decline in mortgage delinquency rate and a 1.38% increase in prepayment rate. Evidence from vehicle registration records suggests that these improvements are driven by reduced automobile reliance, with vehicle spending falling by 6.52%. The effects are most pronounced among financially constrained households, who cut back on low-quality vehicle purchases and exhibit the greatest gains in repayment performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过研究印度德里地铁扩建对抵押贷款还款行为的影响，考察可持续基础设施投资如何影响家庭财务结果。利用印度最大抵押贷款机构之一的行政数据，我们发现，在新开通车站的邮政编码区域，家庭抵押贷款违约率下降了4.42%，提前还款率上升了1.38%。车辆登记记录的证据表明，这些改善是由汽车依赖减少驱动的，车辆支出下降了6.52%。这种效应在财务受限的家庭中最为显著，他们减少了低质量车辆的购买，并在还款表现上获得了最大的改善。

articles.title_cn: 分布敏感的成本效益分析
articles.abstract_en: We propose a method for cost-benefit analysis of public policies that identifies potential Pareto improvements when losers from a reform are compensated through income tax changes. Reforms are desirable when they reduce aggregate excess burden in commodity and labor markets. This condition is equivalent to a weighted sum of individual compensating variations, where weights reflect the impacts of the policy reform on individuals’ labor incomes, rather than marginal social valuations of transfers to them. We identify cases in which distributional weights are increasing in individual incomes, despite inequality concerns.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种公共政策成本效益分析方法，该方法在通过所得税变化补偿改革受损者时，识别潜在的帕累托改进。当改革减少商品和劳动力市场中的总超额负担时，改革是可取的。这一条件等价于个体补偿变异的加权和，其中权重反映政策改革对个体劳动收入的影响，而非对其转移支付的边际社会估值。我们识别了尽管存在不平等关切，但分配权重随个体收入增加而增加的情况。
